name: Adrian Willard
caption: A young wrestler with under two years in the business by his own promos and an NCAA background, who opened the Prodigy Classic against Hornet and lost after twenty-two minutes nineteen seconds.

tenures.source: Named in the fed's own forum posts, 21 June 2011 to 19 July 2011.

name: Lane Cash
caption: A 24-year-old third-generation wrestler from Louisville, Kentucky, a heel cheater who beat Steven Shane by count-out after throwing him off the stage and lost to Impulse in round two of the Prodigy Classic.

name: Steven Shane
caption: 'Sensational' Steven Shane, a tag-team specialist by Lane Cash's own research, who lost to Cash by count-out in round one of the Prodigy Classic.

tenures.source: Named in the fed's own forum posts, 2 June 2011 to 5 July 2011.

name: El Pablo Windham
caption: A masked Windham of the family's Mexican branch, introduced in his handler's roleplay as the half-brother of Nacho Felix, who lost to Anarky in round one of the Prodigy Classic.

tenures.source: Named in the fed's own forum posts, 2 June 2011 to 22 July 2011.

name: Reggie Schrader
caption: The fed's in-fiction announcer, a heavy-set young man in a suit who gives the update from the PWC studios and from each arena.

tenures.source: Named in the fed's own forum posts, 7 March 2011 to 30 August 2011.

name: Bloodhunt
caption: The leader of Doc Silver's Goon Squad, who put Joey Melton on his shoulders for a Headshot in the Prodigy Classic final write-up.

tenures.source: Named in the fed's own forum posts, 19 July 2011 to 30 August 2011.

name: Lex Vicious
caption: A former CSWA Unified champion who, in Joey Melton's roleplay before the Prodigy Classic final, delivered the Viciousbomb to Hornet off a stage as one of the revived Corporation.

tenures.source: Named in the fed's own forum posts, 19 July 2011 to 2 August 2011.
